content.short: CRCI reviews DeFi projects for transparency, user protection, accountability, and execution quality.
content.description: CRCI is a DeFi review and standards project focused on transparency, user protection, and accountability. It evaluates projects through fundamental analysis and presents findings in tools such as the CRCI Matrix, which compares the strength of a project's proposal with the strength of its implementation. For Cardano users and investors, CRCI acts as a due-diligence resource rather than a trading venue. Its goal is to make DeFi project quality easier to judge before users commit time, capital, or trust.
